abstract: We developed a gait foundation model from three-dimensional skeletal motion data of 3,328 deeply phenotyped adults, recorded using a depth camera during five motor tasks. Embeddings significantly predicted 1,887 of 3,210 phenotypic targets and provided predictive gains across all 18 body systems in men and 17 out of 18 in women, while also improving prediction of clinical diagnoses and medication use.
zh_abstract: 我们基于3,328名经过深度表型分析的成年人的三维骨骼运动数据，开发了一个步态基础模型（gait foundation model），这些数据由深度摄像头在五项运动任务中记录。所得嵌入（embeddings）显著预测了3,210个表型目标中的1,887个，在男性的全部18个身体系统以及女性的18个系统中的17个均带来预测增益，同时还改善了对临床诊断和用药情况的预测。

title: Multimodal cell foundation models require synergistic integration beyond alignment
zh_title: 多模态细胞基础模型需要超越对齐的协同整合
summary: 提出基于部分信息分解的协同信息得分，用于衡量冻结单模态专家融合后跨模态交互带来的额外信息增益。
key_points: 针对稀缺配对数据下的组合式基础模型
提出Synergistic Information Score指标
指出对齐类目标可能无法捕捉协同信息
reason: 同行评审的细胞基础模型方法与理论，新意较好，摘要未见外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Integrating measurements across modalities and scales into unified quantitative frameworks of cellular function is a central goal in computational biology. Although powerful unimodal foundation models exist, the scarcity of large-scale paired data limits joint multimodal training. This constraint favours compositional foundation models, which fuse frozen unimodal experts through a learned interface. However, it remains unclear when such fusion provides task-relevant information beyond the strongest unimodal representation rather than merely aggregating redundant signal. Here we introduce Synergistic Information Score, a metric grounded in partial information decomposition that quantifies information gain arising only from cross-modal interactions. Extending theory from self-supervised learning, we show that standard alignment-based objectives with frozen encoders collapse to detect linear redundancies, which constrains their ability to capture nonlinear synergistic states. This distinction is especially important for tasks that connect tissue morphology with gene expression. Benchmarking ten fusion methods on spatial transcriptomics datasets, we demonstrate that tasks dominated by linear redundancies are well served by unimodal baselines, whereas complex niche definitions benefit from synergy-aware integration. Finally, we perform a scaling analysis and show that fine-tuning a dominant unimodal expert is the most sample-efficient strategy for standard tasks. Together, these results suggest that progress in multimodal modelling of cellular state requires shifting from alignment-based objectives to synergy-driven integration that exploits complementary cross-modal signal.
zh_abstract: 将跨模态、跨尺度的测量整合为统一的细胞功能定量框架，是计算生物学的核心目标。尽管已有强大的单模态基础模型，但大规模配对数据的稀缺限制了联合多模态训练。这一限制使得组合式基础模型更具优势，即通过学习得到的接口融合冻结的单模态专家模型。然而，目前尚不清楚这种融合何时能够提供超出最强单模态表征的、与任务相关的信息，而不仅仅是汇聚冗余信号。在此，我们提出协同信息得分（Synergistic Information Score），这是一种基于部分信息分解的指标，用于量化仅由跨模态相互作用产生的信息增益。通过扩展自监督学习的理论，我们表明，采用冻结编码器的标准基于对齐的目标会退化为仅检测线性冗余，这限制了其捕捉非线性协同状态的能力。这一区别对于连接组织形态与基因表达的任务尤为重要。我们在空间转录组学数据集上对十种融合方法进行了基准测试，结果表明，以线性冗余为主的任务使用单模态基线即可很好地完成，而复杂的微环境（niche）定义则受益于考虑协同作用的整合。最后，我们进行了规模扩展分析，结果显示，对于标准任务，微调占主导地位的单模态专家模型是样本效率最高的策略。综上，这些结果提示，细胞状态的多模态建模要取得进展，需要从基于对齐的目标转向利用互补跨模态信号的协同驱动整合。

title: Health-System-Wide Mapping of Demographic Information in Routine Clinical Histopathology
zh_title: 常规临床组织病理中人口学信息的全health system映射
summary: 分析25个器官、257,322名患者的130万张H&E全切片，利用病理基础模型表征评估性别、年龄、种族信息的可恢复性。
key_points: 130万张WSI，25个器官
性别、年龄、种族平均AUROC为0.828、0.733、0.662
类别平衡后性能变化较小
reason: 超大规模病理数据，涉及公平性与基础模型；预印本未提外部验证，限于上限内偏高
abstract: The extent to which demographic-associated information is detectable across organs and disease states in routine clinical histopathology remains unclear. Here, we analyzed 1.3 million hematoxylin and eosin whole-slide images from 257,322 patients across 25 organs, using pathology foundation-model representations and multiple-instance learning to systematically map information associated with sex, age group, and self-reported race. Across 69 organ-demographic combinations, demographic attributes were broadly recoverable, with pan-organ mean AUROCs of 0.828 for sex, 0.733 for age group, and 0.662 for self-reported race, and substantial variation across organs. Demographic-class balancing produced relatively small changes in performance, while evaluation within diagnosis-text clusters showed modest attenuation. Under training with diagnosis-based grouping, demographic-associated signals remained detectable across multiple organs, including sex in gastric tissue (AUROC 0.865), age group in breast (0.816), and self-reported race in skin (0.728). Literature-guided analysis of these settings generated candidate histomorphological and contextual explanations for further investigation. Together, these findings provide a systematic map of demographic-associated information in routine histopathology, informing investigations of its sources, assessments of potential shortcut learning, and the development of more interpretable computational pathology models.
zh_abstract: 在常规临床组织病理学中，与人口统计学相关的信息在多大程度上可跨器官和疾病状态被检测到，目前仍不清楚。本研究分析了来自25个器官、257,322名患者的130万张苏木精-伊红全切片图像，利用病理基础模型表征和多实例学习，系统描绘与性别、年龄组和自报种族相关的信息。在69种器官-人口统计学组合中，人口统计学属性总体上均可被识别：性别、年龄组和自报种族的泛器官平均AUROC分别为0.828、0.733和0.662，且不同器官间差异显著。按人口统计学类别进行均衡处理后，性能变化相对较小；在诊断文本聚类内进行评估时，性能略有减弱。在基于诊断分组的训练下，与人口统计学相关的信号在多个器官中仍可检测到，包括胃组织中的性别（AUROC 0.865）、乳腺中的年龄组（0.816）以及皮肤中的自报种族（0.728）。针对这些情形，结合文献的分析提出了可供进一步研究的候选组织形态学和背景性解释。总之，这些发现提供了常规组织病理学中人口统计学相关信息的系统图谱，可为探究其来源、评估潜在的捷径学习以及开发更具可解释性的计算病理学模型提供参考。

title: Artificial intelligence in glaucoma diagnosis and management: a systematic review of the past decade (2015-2026).
source: PubMed · Expert review of medical devices
zh_title: 青光眼AI诊断与管理系统综述（2015–2026）
summary: 按PRISMA完成系统综述，纳入63项研究，评估青光眼AI技术、影像模态、验证策略及临床转化障碍。
key_points: 检索3758条记录，纳入63项研究
多为眼底照、OCT等深度学习
PROSPERO注册，讨论临床转化障碍
reason: 规范系统综述但纳入量中等，综述档
abstract: [Expert review of medical devices] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being used to support glaucoma detection and monitoring, with rapid advances in deep learning, multimodal imaging, and longitudinal prediction. This review evaluates the evidence supporting these developments and identifies barriers to clinical translation. A systematic search of PubMed, IEEE Xplore, ScienceDirect, and SpringerLink was conducted following PRISMA guidelines, with the protocol registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261450819). Of 3,758 records identified, 63 eligible peer-reviewed studies published between 2015 and 2026 were included. The review examined AI techniques, imaging modalities, datasets, diagnostic and predictive performance, validation strategies, and reported limitations in Glaucoma care. Most studies used deep learning applied to fundus photography, optical coherence tomography (OCT), OCT angiography, visual fields, or multimodal data. Many models achieved an area under the ROC curve of approximately 0.95. AI has substantial potential to improve glaucoma detection and monitoring, but high reported accuracy alone does not establish clinical readiness. Prospective multicenter validation using diverse populations, explainable and reproducible models, standardized evaluation, and integration into clinical workflows are essential before widespread implementation.
zh_abstract: [医疗器械专家评论] 随着深度学习、多模态成像和纵向预测的快速发展，人工智能（AI）正越来越多地用于辅助青光眼的检测和监测。本综述评估了支持这些进展的证据，并指出了临床转化的障碍。我们按照PRISMA指南系统检索了PubMed、IEEE Xplore、ScienceDirect和SpringerLink，研究方案已在PROSPERO注册（CRD420261450819）。在检索到的3,758条记录中，纳入了2015年至2026年间发表的63项符合条件的同行评审研究。本综述考察了青光眼诊疗中的AI技术、成像方式、数据集、诊断和预测性能、验证策略以及报告的局限性。大多数研究将深度学习应用于眼底照相、光学相干断层扫描（OCT）、OCT血管成像、视野或多模态数据。许多模型的ROC曲线下面积约为0.95。AI在改善青光眼检测和监测方面具有巨大潜力，但仅凭报告的高准确性并不能说明其已具备临床应用条件。在广泛应用之前，必须进行涵盖多样化人群的前瞻性多中心验证、采用可解释且可重复的模型、实施标准化评估，并融入临床工作流程。

title: Artificial intelligence analysis of oral mucosal lesions in white-light clinical photographs: A systematic review of visual features and validation.
source: PubMed · European journal of oral sciences
zh_title: 口腔黏膜病变白光照片AI分析的系统综述
summary: 系统综述纳入53项研究，评估AI对口腔白光照片的视觉特征表征、验证与临床转化情况。
key_points: 纳入53项研究，30项发表于2025-2026年
用PROBAST+AI评估偏倚
检索PubMed、Embase、Scopus等库
reason: 系统综述纳入53项研究，有信息量，受综述上限约束
abstract: [European journal of oral sciences] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly applied to conventional oral photographs for recognition, classification, localization, segmentation, and risk assessment of oral mucosal lesions. This systematic review evaluated how clinically relevant visual information-including color, texture, morphology, borders, and spatial patterns-is represented by AI systems and assessed performance, validation, explainability, human comparison, and clinical translation. PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and Google Scholar were searched for studies directly analyzing conventional white-light clinical photographs. Risk of bias was assessed with PROBAST + AI, and certainty with Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation-based approaches. Fifty-three studies were included, 30 published in 2025-2026. Forty-six used implicit deep-learning visual representations, three multimodal vision-language models, two explicit color analyses, and two explicit texture analyses. Thirty-one studies primarily addressed image-level diagnostic classification/recognition, 15 spatial detection/localization or lesion delineation, six screening/triage/referral or biopsy-oriented decision support, and one longitudinal malignant-transformation prediction. Six used independent external cohorts and five compared AI with human readers. Methodological concerns were frequent, no sufficiently coherent group supported meta-analysis, and certainty remained limited across evidence bodies. Current evidence therefore supports technical feasibility rather than established clinical effectiveness, with translation requiring stronger patient-level independence, external validation, prospective multicenter evaluation, and evidence of clinical benefit.
zh_abstract: [欧洲口腔科学杂志] 人工智能（AI）正越来越多地应用于常规口腔照片，以对口腔黏膜病变进行识别、分类、定位、分割和风险评估。本系统综述评估了AI系统如何表征具有临床意义的视觉信息（包括颜色、纹理、形态、边界和空间模式），并评估其性能、验证、可解释性、与人类的比较及临床转化情况。检索了PubMed、Embase、Scopus和Google Scholar中直接分析常规白光临床照片的研究。采用PROBAST + AI评估偏倚风险，并采用基于GRADE（推荐分级评估、制定与评价）的方法评估证据确定性。共纳入53项研究，其中30项发表于2025—2026年。46项使用隐式深度学习视觉表征，3项使用多模态视觉-语言模型，2项使用显式颜色分析，2项使用显式纹理分析。31项研究主要针对图像层面的诊断分类/识别，15项针对空间检测/定位或病变勾画，6项针对筛查/分诊/转诊或以活检为导向的决策支持，1项针对纵向恶性转化预测。6项使用独立的外部队列，5项将AI与人类阅片者进行了比较。方法学问题常见，没有任何足够一致的研究组可支持meta分析，各证据体的确定性仍然有限。因此，目前的证据支持的是技术可行性，而非已确立的临床有效性；要实现临床转化，需要更强的患者层面独立性、外部验证、前瞻性多中心评估以及临床获益的证据。

title: Evidence of limited biases in probed language-based assessments.
source: PubMed · Journal of psychopathology and clinical science
zh_title: 探究式语言评估中偏倚有限的证据
summary: 基于1260名参与者的开放式心理健康描述，用LLM嵌入加岭回归预测抑郁和焦虑症状严重度（r>.60），并检验其是否存在系统性偏倚。
key_points: 1260人开放式描述与PHQ-9、GAD-7对照
LLM嵌入+岭回归，预测r>.60
检验不同人群间的系统性偏倚
reason: 心理健康LLM评估含公平性分析，样本中等，无外部验证
abstract: [Journal of psychopathology and clinical science] Large language models enable increasingly accurate language-based assessments (LBAs) of psychopathology. As these tools are more widely deployed in real-world settings, a critical question emerges: Do these tools work equally well for everyone? We examined whether probed LBAs, in which individuals respond to open-ended mental health questions in their own words, exhibit systematic biases that could undermine their clinical utility. We collected open-ended mental health descriptions from 1,260 participants alongside validated depression (Patient Health Questionnaire-9) and anxiety (Generalized Anxiety Disorder Scale-7) scores. We converted these descriptions to numeric representations using large-language-model-generated embeddings and applied ridge regression to predict symptom severity, achieving strong predictive accuracy (r > .60). We then examined whether assessment differences were systematically associated with sociodemographic factors (gender, age, education, employment, and income) or linguistic characteristics. Our analysis revealed limited evidence of demographic or linguistic bias: Most variables showed minimal association with assessment errors (i.e., the absolute differences between the LBAs and self-reports). However, higher depression and anxiety severity were associated with larger absolute assessment differences (standardized β = .193, p = .038; β = .252, p = .003). We explored mitigation strategies, finding that downsampling training data eliminated the bias for depression and anxiety. Our findings indicate that probed LBAs exhibit limited bias overall, particularly regarding sociodemographic equity. However, the observed severity-related pattern highlights a fundamental challenge. zh_abstract: [Journal of psychopathology and clinical science] 大型语言模型使基于语言的精神病理学评估（language-based assessments, LBAs）越来越准确。随着这些工具在现实环境中得到更广泛的应用，一个关键问题随之出现：这些工具对每个人的效果是否同样好？我们考察了探究式LBAs（即个体用自己的话回答开放式心理健康问题）是否存在可能损害其临床实用性的系统性偏差。我们收集了1,260名参与者的开放式心理健康描述，以及经过验证的抑郁（患者健康问卷-9）和焦虑（广泛性焦虑障碍量表-7）评分。我们使用大型语言模型生成的嵌入将这些描述转换为数值表示，并应用岭回归预测症状严重程度，取得了较高的预测准确度（r > .60）。随后我们考察了评估差异是否与社会人口学因素（性别、年龄、教育、就业和收入）或语言特征存在系统性关联。分析显示，人口学或语言偏差的证据有限：大多数变量与评估误差（即LBAs与自我报告之间的绝对差异）的关联极小。然而，更高的抑郁和焦虑严重程度与更大的绝对评估差异相关（标准化β = .193，p = .038；β = .252，p = .003）。我们探索了缓解策略，发现对训练数据进行降采样可消除抑郁和焦虑方面的偏差。我们的研究结果表明，探究式LBAs总体上表现出的偏差有限，尤其是在社会人口学公平性方面。然而，所观察到的与严重程度相关的模式凸显了一个根本性挑战。(PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2026 APA, all rights reserved)。

title: SeqSol-FECS: An Integrated Deep Learning and Structural Modeling Framework for Protein Solubility Engineering.

abstract: [Biomacromolecules] Escherichia coli is widely used as a workhorse for heterologous protein expression. However, insoluble protein expression is frequently encountered. The mechanisms underlying protein solubility remain incompletely understood, limiting the effectiveness of current protein solubility engineering strategies. Here, SeqSol, a sequence-level solubility prediction model capable of prioritizing single-amino-acid substitutions through WT-mutant rescoring, was developed using 71,425 proteins. SeqSol achieved an accuracy of 75.8% and an AUC of 0.840 on an independent test set and correctly identified experimentally validated solubility-enhancing mutations from diverse proteins. To minimize the risk of activity loss, candidate mutation sites were prioritized according to conformational flexibility, relative solvent accessibility, and evolutionary conservation before solubility engineering. Using only 30 experimentally tested mutations, the resulting SeqSol-FECS framework increased the solubility of two industrial enzymes from 56.18% and 10.53% to over 95%, respectively, while maintaining their specific activities. SeqSol-FECS provides an efficient strategy for enzyme solubility engineering and biomanufacturing applications.
zh_abstract: [Biomacromolecules] 大肠杆菌被广泛用作异源蛋白表达的主力宿主。然而，不溶性蛋白表达经常出现。蛋白质溶解度背后的机制仍未被完全阐明，限制了现有蛋白质溶解度工程策略的效果。在此，我们利用71,425个蛋白质开发了SeqSol，这是一种序列水平的溶解度预测模型，能够通过野生型-突变体重新评分对单氨基酸替换进行优先排序。SeqSol在独立测试集上的准确率为75.8%，AUC为0.840，并能正确识别来自多种蛋白质的、经实验验证的提高溶解度的突变。为尽量降低活性丧失的风险，在进行溶解度工程之前，根据构象柔性、相对溶剂可及性和进化保守性对候选突变位点进行了优先排序。仅通过30个经实验测试的突变，所得的SeqSol-FECS框架就将两种工业酶的溶解度分别从56.18%和10.53%提高到95%以上，同时保持了其比活性。SeqSol-FECS为酶溶解度工程和生物制造应用提供了一种高效策略。

title: Impact of training data on deep learning-based RNA 3D structure quality assessment.
zh_title: 训练数据对深度学习RNA三维结构质量评估的影响
summary: 对三种RNA 3D结构质量评估模型进行跨数据集重训练分析，并构建新数据集RNA3DQA，在RNA-Puzzles上评估。
key_points: 系统比较模型架构与训练数据的贡献

abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] Accurate reference-free assessment of predicted RNA 3D structures is essential for large-scale RNA modeling, yet the impact of training data on deep learning-based quality predictors remains poorly understood. Here, we present a systematic cross-training analysis of three deep learning predictors for RNA 3D structure quality assessment, each originally developed on distinct training sets. By retraining each predictor on alternative (nonnative) datasets-including RNA3DQA, a new set created specifically for this project-and evaluating performance on independent RNA-Puzzles benchmarks, we systematically assess the relative contributions of model architecture and training data composition. Our results reveal pronounced differences in cross-dataset generalization, with predictors often performing better when trained on nonnative datasets than on their native ones. Notably, the impact of the training datasets varied across predictors, with RNA3DQA yielding the overall best accuracy and ranking stability results specifically for the ARES model. Native training sets yielded better performance for RNA3DCNN and lociPARSE. These findings demonstrate that the characteristics of the training data play a dominant, model-dependent role in shaping the performance and robustness of reference-free RNA 3D structure quality assessment methods. We conclude with practical recommendations for designing transferable training datasets and for benchmarking deep learning-based quality predictors in RNA structural bioinformatics.

abstract: Clinical biosignals such as ECG, PPG, and EEG are increasingly acquired as hours-long streams from bedside monitors and wearables, yet existing analysis pipelines almost universally operate on isolated short windows of around 10 seconds and cannot process the long, irregular, frequently interrupted signals. We introduce BioLT, a streaming decoder-only framework for long-context biosignal modeling that turns any window-level feature extractor or pretrained biosignal foundation model into a streaming model. BioLT combines (i) a discontinuity-aware encoding that exposes the inter-window elapsed time as an explicit input channel, so that the decoder can learn to model these gaps as clinically meaningful information, and (ii) a fixed-size compressed memory bank supervised with cumulative summary statistics, which keeps both training and inference linear in the recording length while preserving long-range context. We evaluate on CPSC-2021, VitalDB, MC-MED, and CHB-MIT for arrhythmia, sepsis, and seizure detection and for forecasting up to 20 minutes ahead, using domain features and embeddings from six biosignal foundation models. Across 21 dataset-feature settings, BioLT achieves the highest detection AUROC in 15 and the highest 20-minute forecasting AUROC in 13 settings, and shows consistent performance gains over state-of-the-art snapshot foundation-model embeddings. These highlight the importance of modeling how streaming biosignal representations evolve over time, beyond improving window-level representations alone.

abstract: We introduce Cadense, a generative framework for antibody ensemble prediction that produces diverse Fv structures from sequence, informed by conformational dynamics. While a valuable resource, static structure prediction provides only a single snapshot of dynamic proteins, whose motions influence their binding and other properties. This is particularly relevant for antibodies, an important class of molecules for drug discovery, where flexible complementarity determining region (CDR) loops are difficult to model with static approaches. Cadense addresses this gap by generating ensembles that match conformational and biophysical property distributions from molecular dynamics (MD), while reducing the computational burden from days of simulation to seconds of generation. We show Cadense ensembles can recover both apo and holo conformations of the same antibody and serve as effective input to physics-based docking, capturing the conformational flexibility important to properly model antibody antigen interactions. Together, these results establish Cadense as a useful tool for antibody conformational ensemble generation with the promise to enable faster, dynamics-aware antibody design.
zh_abstract: 我们介绍 Cadense，这是一种用于抗体构象系综预测的生成式框架，能够在构象动力学的指导下从序列生成多样化的 Fv 结构。静态结构预测虽然是一种有价值的资源，但对于动态蛋白质只能提供单一快照，而其运动会影响结合及其他性质。这对抗体尤为重要，抗体是药物发现中的一类重要分子，其灵活的互补决定区（CDR）环难以用静态方法建模。Cadense 通过生成与分子动力学（MD）所得构象和生物物理性质分布相匹配的系综来弥补这一空白，同时将计算负担从数天的模拟缩减至数秒的生成。我们表明，Cadense 系综能够还原同一抗体的 apo 和 holo 两种构象，并可作为基于物理的对接的有效输入，捕捉对于正确建模抗体-抗原相互作用十分重要的构象灵活性。总之，这些结果表明 Cadense 是用于生成抗体构象系综的有用工具，有望实现更快速、兼顾动力学的抗体设计。

abstract: In mass-spectrometry-based proteomics, a substantial proportion of acquired spectra remain unidentified, concealing a vast reservoir of biological variations commonly termed the "dark proteome", potentially obscuring sequence mutations, non-canonical peptides and post-translational modifications. Existing deep-learning methods largely rely on supervised training with peptide-spectrum matches (PSMs), limiting their ability to learn from the much larger pool of unannotated spectra. Here we introduce {pi}-SPECFormer, a mass-spectrometry foundation model pre-trained on 291 million spectra through a two-stage framework that combines self-supervised and PSMs-guided representation learning. {pi}-SPECFormer transfers effectively to de novo peptide sequencing, spectrum clustering and modification detection, consistently outperforming task-specific baselines. When applied to proteomic profiles from 103 individuals with lung adenocarcinoma, the model identified nine high-confidence mutated peptides, including six that were absent from the reference databases. {pi}-SPECFormer thus enables unbiased decoding of molecular complexity beyond the boundaries of the canonical proteome.

abstract: Radiology AI has developed along two paths: specialized models that perform well on narrow tasks but cover few clinical findings, and generalist models that address a broader range of tasks but remain prone to hallucination and inaccurate measurements. Combining the two through agentic systems offers a route towards comprehensive radiology reporting, but published systems are tied to one modality or body part. We describe a radiology agentic framework that standardizes how an orchestrator calls modular tools to produce a structured report, and use it to measure what such a system can do with the tools from FDA-cleared radiology AI devices. Report generation is simulated on a large multi-modality report corpus, with the orchestrator given either a catalog of finding classes consolidated from the cleared devices, each available on the modalities it is cleared for, or an unlimited catalog in which any class can be requested, and planning either from the clinical indication or from the target report. Tool outputs are simulated from the reference report, so the comparison isolates tool availability and orchestration from tool error. With the cleared catalog and the indication alone, the orchestrator recovers under a third of the clinically actionable findings; recovery improves substantially with the unlimited catalog, and further when the plan is written from the target report. Attributing every missed finding to a cause shows that most are classes no cleared device offers for the study's modality, and that a third are classes or tools that were offered and not called. Adding the most frequently missing tools closes most of the gap to the unlimited catalog on held-out reports, whereas a smaller orchestrator with the unlimited catalog gives up the whole gain. Tool availability and effective orchestration are thus complementary constraints on comprehensive AI-assisted radiology reporting.
zh_abstract: 放射学人工智能沿两条路径发展：专用模型在狭窄任务上表现良好，但涵盖的临床发现很少；通用模型可处理更广泛的任务，但仍易出现幻觉和测量不准确。通过智能体（agentic）系统将二者结合，为实现全面的放射学报告提供了一条途径，但已发表的系统均局限于单一模态或单一身体部位。我们描述了一个放射学智能体框架，该框架规范了协调器（orchestrator）调用模块化工具以生成结构化报告的方式，并用它来衡量此类系统借助美国 FDA 批准的放射学 AI 设备中的工具所能完成的工作。我们在一个大型多模态报告语料库上模拟报告生成：协调器获得的要么是由已获批设备整合而成的发现类别目录（每个类别仅在其获批的模态上可用），要么是可请求任意类别的无限目录；规划则要么基于临床适应证，要么基于目标报告。工具输出根据参考报告模拟，因此该比较将工具可用性和协调能力与工具误差区分开来。在使用已获批目录且仅依据适应证时，协调器仅能找回不到三分之一的具有临床可操作性的发现；使用无限目录后找回率显著提高，当计划基于目标报告撰写时进一步提高。将每个遗漏的发现归因于具体原因后发现，大多数是该研究模态下没有任何已获批设备提供的类别，另有三分之一是已提供但未被调用的类别或工具。在保留的报告上，加入最常缺失的工具可弥合与无限目录之间的大部分差距，而使用较小的协调器配合无限目录则会丧失全部增益。因此，工具可用性与有效的协调能力是对全面的 AI 辅助放射学报告互补的两项约束。

abstract: Digital twins of intensive care patients should update forecasts from new data and predict treatment responses, but few studies test whether routine records support either. We propose ICare-DT, a Transformer-based twin that updates a latent patient state hourly from new measurements without retraining. We trained it on 140,473 eICU-CRD stays to forecast vital signs crossing their training-set means. On test data, later forecasts beat the twin's own hour-6 forecasts of the same windows in all 12 settings (+0.073 to +0.153 AUROC). On validation data, controls that withheld or swapped the new hours traced the gain to the patient's own measurements. Without refitting, the model kept its gain on a second database (8 of 9 settings, +0.025 to +0.114 AUROC) in a prespecified evaluation of the previously analyzed MIMIC-IV test split. Refitted within MIMIC-IV, a twin state fine-tuned on clinical endpoints gave gradient boosting a significant gain for acute kidney injury (+0.0035 AUROC; hypotension +0.0010, not significant). To test response prediction, we built a benchmark that replaces the treatments in real records with simulated doses and injects responses of known size, visible only at measurement times. Ridge models supervised with injected effects recovered them from real records only through frequently measured variables (heart rate) read at their measurement times. We asked standard learners to predict these effects for a dosing regime no patient had received. No standard learner outperformed predicting zero effect at an out-of-support query. When told how the simulated responses were generated, a separate learner recovered the effects from the same records without seeing their true values (R2 0.30 to 0.40 at one effect size). Routine records support forecasts that improve with each patient's new data, and our benchmark is a testbed for models that learn how responses are generated.

abstract: [medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences] Rheumatic mitral stenosis (RMS) disproportionately affects low-resource settings where echocardiography is limited. We evaluated foundation model (FM) feasibility for RMS detection using limited, indirectly labeled ECGs. An ECG-FM was fine-tuned using 804 RMS-positive ECGs per fold and externally validated across clinical and wearable lead configurations. Internal AUROCs were 0.89, 0.87, and 0.87, for 12-Lead, 6-Lead, and 1-Lead respectively. External AUROCs were 0.82, 0.80, and 0.77. Performance remained comparable across demographic subgroups. FM fine-tuning enables RMS detection using limited ICD-derived labels, supporting further evaluation of reduced-lead ECG screening and echocardiography triage in resource-constrained settings.

abstract: Pathology reporting requires translating tissue observations across regions and slides into specific diagnoses and supporting morphological descriptions. However, the use of explicit tissue-composition measurements to guide H&E-based report generation remains underexplored. Thus, we developed PathXAI, which combines segmentation-derived tissue information with H&E images and optional domain knowledge to guide diagnostic reasoning, targeted reinspection and structured report writing. Its segmentation component exceeded baselines in mean Dice on internal and external tests. In automated report evaluation on 1,200 public and 151 private cases, PathXAI achieved higher agreement with reference diagnoses and documented morphology than the H&E-based comparators. On the public evaluation cohort, PathXAI-Report exceeded Qwen + H&E in cancer family match rate by 4.4 percentage points and in finding F1 by 5.7 percentage points. PathXAI generates evidence-linked reports with a self-hosted pretrained vision-language model, without updating its weights.

abstract: [Medical physics] Accurate and comprehensive segmentation of pulmonary vasculature is essential for diagnosing various pulmonary diseases and lung surgical planning. To develop a deep learning model for pulmonary vessels segmentation based on both computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA) and non-contrast computed tomography (NCCT) data, and to evaluate its performance on a clinical dataset. In this retrospective study, we collected 427 cases of chest CT data from different countries and manufacturers, including 213 CTPA cases and 214 NCCT cases. And we designed a CTPA and NCCT ground truth (GT) generation method producing high-accuracy vessel annotation dataset. Then we developed a 3D U-Net based deep learning method with the Vessel Lumen Structure Optimization Module (VLSOM). We numerically evaluated model using metrics including Centerline Recall (Cl-Recall), Centerline DICE (Cl-DICE), Average Symmetric Surface Distance (ASSD) and 95% Hausdorff Distance (HD95) focusing on the integrity of vascular structures. Finally, the model performance was visually assessed in an independent external dataset. In the numerical evaluation on the internal test dataset with 57 cases, our model achieved Cl-DICE, Cl-Recall and HD95 values of 0.909 (95% CI [0.904, 0.914]), 0.883 (95% CI [0.873, 0.891]) and 1.861 mm (95% CI [1.674 mm, 2.073 mm]) which is superior to the state of the art (SOTA) baseline model nnU-Net v2 of 0.860 (95% CI [0.852, 0.867]), 0.772 (95% CI [0.760, 0.783])and 2.458 mm (95% CI [2.219 mm, 2.708 mm]) (all p < 0.001). In the clinical visual assessments on the 90 sets of external datasets, the average score for accuracy and robustness, branch abundance, computer-aided detection and vascular continuity 4.52 (95% CI [4.42, 4.62]), 4.82 (95% CI [4.76, 4.90]), 4.58 (95% CI [4.46, 4.69]), and 4.85 (95% CI [4.77, 4.92]) respectively with a full score of 5. The proposed pulmonary vessel segmentation algorithm performed well in preserving the connectivity and integrity of the vascular structure on both CTPA and NCCT data with various diseases. A vessel centerline topology-enhanced deep segmentation model enables accurate and automatic pulmonary vessel segmentation in both computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA) and non-contrast computed tomography (NCCT) images.

abstract: [Romanian journal of ophthalmology] We reviewed various ocular biomarkers relevant to gastrointestinal (GI) disorders and examined the potential role of artificial intelligence (AI) in detecting, integrating, and translating these biomarkers into clinical gastroenterology practice. A literature search from PubMed, MEDLINE, Scopus, Google Scholar, and Web of Science from the year 2000 up to February 2026 was conducted. We included published articles on ocular findings in gastrointestinal disorders and/or AI-based analysis of ocular biomarkers with gastrointestinal connections. Results suggested a positive correlation between AI-based ocular biomarkers and GI disorders. After reviewing the literature, we found that the most frequently described ocular biomarkers were retinal vascular caliber and arteriovenous ratio on fundus photography; retinal nerve fibre layer and choroidal changes on optical coherence tomography; and vessel-density changes on optical coherence tomography angiography. The persistent signal came from inflammatory bowel disease and steatotic liver disease. AI may improve image processing, feature extraction, and pattern recognition, but more multicentric studies are needed to establish definitive analogy. This review suggests that ocular biomarkers could provide a simple, non-invasive way to identify and monitor gastrointestinal diseases, especially inflammatory bowel disease and steatotic liver disease. Changes in retinal blood vessels, the retinal nerve fibre layer, the choroid, and OCTA-derived vessel density may reflect the inflammation, metabolic disturbances, and small-vessel changes associated with these conditions. However, these findings should be interpreted with caution because many existing studies included small or selected patient groups, used cross-sectional designs, applied different imaging methods, and did not consistently account for factors such as age, vascular risk, medications, or coexisting eye disease. Still, high model performance alone does not prove that these tools are accurate, reliable, or specific enough for clinical use. abstract: [JMIR bioinformatics and biotechnology] The assessment of the risk of bias (RoB) of each study is a necessary but labor-intensive step in conducting a systematic review (SR). There is a potential for AI to reduce the time and effort needed for RoB assessment and improve consistency between reviewers, but little is known about the accuracy of AI-based RoB assessments. In this study, we aim to evaluate the performance of a large language model (LLM) when given the questions from the RoB tool and the relevant passages from the full-text papers in assessing RoB in observational studies of environmental exposures and health outcomes. We evaluated the performance of GPT-5-mini on 128 observational studies from a SR of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances and health outcomes conducted by the National Academies of Sciences. The navigation guide (NavGuide), a domain-based RoB tool designed for environmental studies, was used. For each paper-domain pair, the LLM was provided with the questions and guidance from the NavGuide and the human-identified text passages addressing that domain. The LLM returned a structured RoB rating, which was compared to the human-adjudicated ratings to quantify agreement and identify patterns of discrepancy. GPT-5-mini RoB assessments for exact matches (64.5%; κ=0.199, Gwet AC2=0.882, F1-score=0.311) remained lower than the concordance between humans and the reference standard (87.5%-91.4%). Performance improved substantially for partial matches, reflecting agreement in direction but not necessarily in magnitude (eg, "low" and "probably low"), with percent concordance of 91.9% (κ=0.241, Gwet AC2=0.910, F1-score=0.614; for humans, 97.9%-98.6% concordance). Performance varied across the NavGuide domains, with the worst performance in domain 1 (selection bias) and the best in domain 4 (outcome assessment). The models tended to be more stringent than humans, often assigning higher RoB ratings (eg, "probably low" when humans assigned "low"). Our results suggest that although concordance was moderate and inconsistent across domains, LLMs may be sufficiently accurate for use with human oversight. LLMs can flag cases for human adjudication or consistency checking but are not ready for use as an independent second reviewer without human oversight.
zh_abstract: [JMIR bioinformatics and biotechnology] 对每项研究进行偏倚风险（RoB）评估是开展系统综述（SR）中必要但耗费人力的步骤。人工智能有可能减少RoB评估所需的时间和精力，并提高评价者之间的一致性，但关于基于AI的RoB评估准确性的了解甚少。本研究旨在评估大语言模型（LLM）在获得RoB工具的问题及全文论文相关段落的情况下，评估环境暴露与健康结局观察性研究RoB的表现。我们在美国国家科学院开展的一项关于全氟和多氟烷基物质与健康结局的系统综述中的128项观察性研究上评估了GPT-5-mini的表现。使用的是专为环境研究设计的基于领域的RoB工具——导航指南（navigation guide，NavGuide）。对于每一个论文-领域对，向LLM提供NavGuide的问题和指导，以及人工识别出的涉及该领域的文本段落。LLM返回结构化的RoB评级，并与人工裁定的评级进行比较，以量化一致性并识别差异模式。GPT-5-mini的RoB评估在完全匹配方面（64.5%；κ=0.199，Gwet AC2=0.882，F1分数=0.311）仍低于人工与参考标准之间的一致性（87.5%–91.4%）。在部分匹配方面表现显著改善，即方向一致但程度不一定一致（例如“低”与“可能低”），一致率为91.9%（κ=0.241，Gwet AC2=0.910，F1分数=0.614；人工为97.9%–98.6%）。不同NavGuide领域的表现各异，领域1（选择偏倚）最差，领域4（结局评估）最好。模型往往比人工更为严格，常给出更高的RoB评级（例如人工评为“低”时模型评为“可能低”）。我们的结果提示，尽管一致性处于中等水平且各领域间不一致，LLM在有人工监督的情况下可能具有足够的准确性。LLM可用于标记需要人工裁定或一致性核查的病例，但在没有人工监督的情况下尚不能作为独立的第二评价者使用。

abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] Clinical large language model agents depend on both model capability and the surrounding system that selects information, constrains actions, and verifies execution. In this Viewpoint, we argue that this harness should be an explicit unit of clinical agent design, evaluation, and reporting. Our aim is to help clinical informatics and development teams specify this layer and to help evaluators and institutional governance teams assess its contributions and risks. Selected benchmarks show substantial performance differences across harness configurations, but architecture comparisons, bundled improvements, and within-model component comparisons support different levels of causal attribution. We propose a revisable 3-tier framework: tier 1 specifies general orchestration functions, including prompts, tools, output schemas, control flow, memory, and generic verification; tier 2 specifies their clinical adaptations for knowledge integration, differential reasoning, missingness and temporality, safety verification, and workflow alignment; and tier 3 specifies a failure-driven evaluation cycle applied to both. Our contribution is a framework that makes these connections explicit. We provide classification rules, an illustrative clinical example, a proposed evaluation protocol, and a minimum reporting checklist. Observable execution traces are distinguished from private model reasoning, with provenance and privacy safeguards supporting retrospective reconstruction. Evaluation should separate task success, clinical correctness, process safety, and operational reliability. Lightweight fine-tuning can complement harness design; their interaction requires controlled study. The framework is a proposal for empirical testing, not a validated taxonomy or evidence of deployment safety.

abstract: [Ultrasonic imaging] This study introduces MSF-US, a novel deep learning framework integrating multi-scale feature fusion and attention mechanisms. It aims to enhance early breast cancer detection and improve diagnostic accuracy in ultrasound images, particularly addressing the challenges of capturing global and local features in dense breast tissue. The MSF-US model combines hierarchical multi-scale feature extraction with attention mechanisms to selectively focus on diagnostically relevant regions. The framework was rigorously validated on a multi-center dataset of breast ultrasound images. Its performance was compared against state-of-the-art models, such as ResNet-50, Vision Transformer (ViT), and Swin Transformer, evaluating accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and area under the curve (AUC). In 5-fold cross-validation, MSF-US yielded an average accuracy of 0.9057, sensitivity of 0.9075, and AUC of 0.9212 with high net clinical benefit. On the independent C3 test set, it surpassed 8 SOTA baselines with a peak accuracy of 0.9406, F1 score of 0.9483, and AUC of 0.9391. Evaluation on 3 diverse public cohorts (BUSI, BUS-BRA, and BrEaST) confirmed excellent cross-center generalizability, achieving AUCs up to 0.9519. Ablation analysis validated that the synergy of multi-scale feature fusion and attention mechanisms significantly boosted diagnostic precision over single-scale baselines. MSF-US delivers state-of-the-art performance in breast ultrasound imaging, offering a highly reliable tool for early breast cancer detection. Its innovative design successfully addresses the limitations of existing methods, presenting significant clinical potential to improve diagnostic accuracy and patient outcomes.

abstract: Protein motif scaffolding benchmarks assess whether generative models can build scaffolds around functionally important residues. Their conclusions depend on which motifs are tested and which criteria define success. Existing benchmarks typically use small hand-curated motif sets and static refolding criteria, but protein function often depends on conformational ensembles and transitions. Here, we address both benchmark scope and success criteria. We introduce BILBY-PRO, a systematically derived benchmark of structurally conserved functional motifs from PROSITE-linked experimental structures, comprising 220 cases from 174 PROSITE motif-pattern entries. Evaluating six recent scaffold-generation models reveals distinct patterns in target coverage and unique-solution yield: RFDiffusion and Proteina solve more targets, whereas ESM3 produces more unique successful scaffolds on the targets it solves. We further introduce BILBY-MD, a reference-based all-atom molecular dynamics evaluation framework. Applied to statically solved designs from the original MotifBench benchmark, it compares motif drift, scaffold drift, motif-contact preservation, and motif-dihedral free-energy landscapes against reference simulations. Of 55 statically solved model-problem pairs, 31 satisfy our MD-supported criterion and only 8 pass all checks. Compact, self-contained motifs are often MD-supported, whereas interface-like or context-dependent motifs fail more frequently. Static refolding success therefore provides useful evidence of local motif recovery but does not establish dynamical fidelity of the full scaffold. BILBY highlights three complementary axes of motif-scaffolding evaluation: target coverage, unique-solution yield, and MD-supported dynamical fidelity.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质基序支架（motif scaffolding）基准用于评估生成模型能否围绕功能上重要的残基构建支架。其结论取决于所测试的基序以及定义成功的标准。现有基准通常使用小规模、人工筛选的基序集和静态重折叠标准，但蛋白质功能往往取决于构象系综及其转变。在此，我们同时解决基准范围和成功标准两方面的问题。我们提出了BILBY-PRO，这是一个由系统方法得到的、来自与PROSITE关联的实验结构的结构保守功能基序基准，包含来自174个PROSITE基序模式条目的220个案例。对六个近期支架生成模型的评估显示，它们在目标覆盖率和独特解产出方面呈现出不同模式：RFDiffusion和Proteina解决的目标更多，而ESM3在其所解决的目标上产生更多独特的成功支架。我们进一步提出了BILBY-MD，一种基于参照的全原子分子动力学评估框架。将其应用于原始MotifBench基准中静态求解成功的设计时，它将基序漂移、支架漂移、基序接触保留以及基序二面角自由能景观与参照模拟进行比较。在55个静态求解成功的模型-问题配对中，31个满足我们的MD支持标准，仅8个通过全部检查。紧凑、自包含的基序通常得到MD支持，而界面样或依赖上下文的基序失败更为频繁。因此，静态重折叠成功为局部基序恢复提供了有用证据，但并不能确立完整支架的动力学保真度。BILBY突出了基序支架评估的三个互补维度：目标覆盖率、独特解产出以及MD支持的动力学保真度。

abstract: [European heart journal. Digital health] Evidence-based medicine represents the systematic approach through which physicians today use the best available scientific evidence from clinical research to guide their clinical decision-making process. However, the emergence of artificial intelligence (AI), with its diverse models and potential applications in medicine, is leading to a new form of research driven by 'big data' and heterogeneous datasets, extending beyond conventional statistical analysis and thereby making AI literacy an increasingly essential competence for clinicians. Artificial intelligence applications in cardiology have shown potential to support disease diagnosis, risk prediction, workflow efficiency, and therapeutic decision-making. However, despite these opportunities, AI may also represent a technological barrier for many physicians, due to its mathematical foundations and the speed at which models evolve. A solid understanding of AI concepts is therefore necessary for cardiologists to critically interpret results and engage with this new research landscape. This scientific statement explores AI in cardiology from an educational perspective, outlining the key knowledge required to build adequate AI literacy. The goal is to enable cardiologists not only to avoid reliance on external experts for methodological decisions, but also to collaborate with greater insight and informed judgment.

abstract: Alternative polyadenylation (APA) changes which regulatory sequences an RNA retains, creating a layer of cellular variation that gene-level expression profiles cannot resolve. Here we present scPolyA, a unified, AI-enabled framework that transforms conventional single-cell and spatial 3'-end transcriptomes into quantitative maps of RNA-end choice. scPolyA connects de novo poly(A)-site discovery to cell- and spot-resolved measurements of terminal-site usage, 3' untranslated region length and intronic polyadenylation, enabling differential APA analysis across cell states and tissue regions. Its integrated deep-learning module, DeepCPS, improves recognition of sparsely supported poly(A) sites and predicts cleavage positions at nucleotide resolution. An integrated graphical workspace brings parameter exploration, efficient rerunning and genome browsing together, while an APA-specialised AI agent translates natural-language research questions into executed analyses, verified outputs and evidence-guided interpretation. Across diverse single-cell protocols and spatial platforms, scPolyA achieves higher reference-atlas agreement than most evaluated de novo methods, while single-cell benchmarks demonstrate competitive runtime and memory use. Applied to cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma, scPolyA reveals recurrent 3' untranslated region shortening in tumour keratinocytes across all ten patients and corresponding patterns in tumour-enriched regions, with tissue-level contrasts shaped by cellular composition. scPolyA extends conventional transcriptomics from gene abundance to RNA-end regulation, linking transcript choices to cellular states and tissue organisation.

abstract: We introduce MELD (Mutation Effect Learning through Differential Embeddings), a compact model for predicting the functional consequences of single nucleotide variants (SNVs) by training directly on the wild-type (WT) versus mutant differential. Interpreting SNVs is central to clinical genomics, yet experimental characterization cannot scale to millions of observed variants. Leading sequence-to-function models (Enformer, Borzoi, AlphaGenome) are trained on absolute genomic tracks and score variants post hoc through in-silico mutagenesis (ISM), so the WT-mutant difference never enters the training loss. MELD instead places the logit difference {Delta}z = zmut - zwt inside the supervised objective. It combines a shared CNN-Transformer encoder, a mutant-specific mutation-mask boost, multiscale mutation-centered pooling, and a learned adaptive amplification factor . On ClinVar (1.57M variants), MELD (1.9M parameters) reached an AUROC of 0.986 versus 0.800 for a same-data, same-backbone ISM baseline, with ablations confirming the contribution of each component. On a shared benchmark, it outperformed frozen foundation models with 3-1,300x more parameters (AUROC 0.967 vs. 0.924 for AlphaGenome and 0.936 for Nucleotide Transformer). With only 50, 000 training variants, it exceeded the ISM baseline trained on all 1.48M (AUROC 0.903 vs. 0.796) variants. On BRCA1 saturation genome editing, frozen MELD achieved a Spearman {rho} of 0.42, above Borzoi (0.40), and ClinVar transfer raised it to 0.45. These results demonstrate that direct differential supervision is a compact, data-efficient alternative to post-hoc ISM scoring with substantially larger pretrained models.

key_points: 含mFrag-Weight与mFrag-Net两种方法
训练集287名肺癌风险人群
独立测试集385例对照、46例肺癌
reason: 预印本，有独立测试集但样本较小
abstract: Fragmentomics analyzes features of circulating cell-free DNA fragments (e.g., fragment length or end motifs) derived from whole-genome sequencing of liquid biopsy samples (blood or other body fluids), enabling non-invasive early cancer detection. Here we present mFrag, a framework that integrates external methylation reference atlases with fragmentomic features for lung cancer detection. mFrag comprises two complementary methods: mFrag-Weight, which uses DNA methylation information to weight fragmentomic features, and mFrag-Net, which integrates fragmentomic features and external DNA methylation data through neural networks. We average the output probabilities of the two methods to obtain a final prediction score. The mFrag model was trained using 287 individuals at risk for lung cancer. In an independent case-control testing set comprising 385 non-cancer controls and 46 cancers (28 stage I, 12 stage II, and 6 stage III or IV), mFrag outperforms a DELFI-style fragmentomic approach, improving PR-AUC from 0.455 to 0.720 and sensitivity at 99% specificity from 0.043 to 0.478, with ROC-AUC from 0.871 to 0.908. For stage I lung cancer, mFrag raises PR-AUC from 0.314 to 0.558 and ROC-AUC from 0.855 to 0.894. Applied to end 4-mer motif features, mFrag likewise improved over an unweighted baseline, with gains contributed by both mFrag-Weight and mFrag-Net. In summary, mFrag improves the accuracy of fragmentomics-based lung cancer detection through integrating external DNA methylation data and the complementarity of its two component models, without incurring any additional data-generating cost.
zh_abstract: 片段组学（Fragmentomics）分析源自液体活检样本（血液或其他体液）全基因组测序的循环游离DNA片段特征（如片段长度或末端基序），可实现无创早期癌症检测。在此，我们提出mFrag，一个将外部甲基化参考图谱与片段组学特征相整合用于肺癌检测的框架。mFrag包含两种互补方法：mFrag-Weight利用DNA甲基化信息对片段组学特征加权；mFrag-Net通过神经网络整合片段组学特征与外部DNA甲基化数据。我们对两种方法的输出概率取平均，得到最终预测分数。mFrag模型使用287名肺癌风险个体进行训练。在一个独立的病例-对照测试集中（包含385名非癌症对照和46例癌症，其中I期28例、II期12例、III或IV期6例），mFrag优于DELFI式片段组学方法：PR-AUC从0.455提高到0.720，99%特异性下的敏感性从0.043提高到0.478，ROC-AUC从0.871提高到0.908。对于I期肺癌，mFrag将PR-AUC从0.314提高到0.558，ROC-AUC从0.855提高到0.894。应用于末端4-mer基序特征时，mFrag同样优于未加权基线，且mFrag-Weight和mFrag-Net均有贡献。总之，mFrag通过整合外部DNA甲基化数据以及两个组成模型的互补性，提高了基于片段组学的肺癌检测准确性，且不产生任何额外的数据生成成本。

title: Realism and resolution: How AI-predicted protein structures differ from experimental structures
zh_title: AI预测蛋白结构与实验结构的真实性与分辨率差异
summary: 提出WhatRes，从坐标评估表观分辨率与真实性，发现高置信度预测模型仍存在键长键角变化偏小的过度理想化。
key_points: 两轴评估：表观分辨率与真实性
预测模型几何变异低于高分辨率晶体结构
高置信度模型同样存在过度理想化
reason: 预印本，新评估方法有价值但证据有限
abstract: Protein structure predictors can recover protein folds with remarkable accuracy, and their models are increasingly used as if they were experimental structures. Yet even for a confidently predicted fold, it remains difficult to judge how faithfully the model reproduces protein geometry. We introduce WhatRes, which assesses a structure from its coordinates on two complementary axes. Apparent resolution estimates the experimental resolution its local geometry most closely resembles. Realism measures how closely that geometry matches experimental structures at the same apparent resolution. Predicted models can score well on apparent resolution while showing systematically less variation in bond lengths and angles than is observed in high-resolution crystal structures. WhatRes reveals this over-idealisation even in high-confidence models.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质结构预测工具能够以惊人的准确度还原蛋白质折叠，其预测模型也越来越多地被当作实验结构来使用。然而，即使对于预测置信度很高的折叠，也仍难以判断该模型对蛋白质几何结构的还原有多忠实。我们提出了 WhatRes，它根据坐标在两个互补的维度上评估结构。表观分辨率（apparent resolution）用于估计其局部几何结构与哪种实验分辨率最为接近。真实度（realism）用于衡量该几何结构与处于相同表观分辨率的实验结构的匹配程度。预测模型在表观分辨率上可能得分很好，但其键长和键角的变异却系统性地小于高分辨率晶体结构中观察到的变异。WhatRes 揭示了这种过度理想化现象，即使在高置信度模型中也是如此。

title: GeneEmbedLLM: Harnessing Large Language Models for Gene Functional Embedding and Association Prediction
zh_title: GeneEmbedLLM：用大语言模型生成基因功能嵌入
summary: 整合五个数据库的文本注释，基于Longformer与对比学习生成基因嵌入，并在多项下游任务上验证。
key_points: 整合五个权威数据库的多源结构化文本
采用基于Longformer的属性感知注意力
下游任务涵盖分子互作、表型依赖与表观调控
reason: 新方法有基线对比，但摘要未见代码与外部验证细节
abstract: Effective and high-quality gene function representations are crucial for bioinformatics tasks. While biological knowledge about genes is inherently textual, encompassing functional descriptions and pathway annotations, current methods often rely on single-source, non-textual data, failing to capture the rich semantic information in multi-source gene annotations. In this paper, we propose GeneEmbedLLM, a Large Language Model (LLM)-powered framework for generating universal, semantically-aware gene embeddings. The proposed approach advances the gene representation learning through multi-source structured text integration from five authoritative databases and attribute-aware attention based on Longformer architecture and contrastive learning. Experimental results on diverse downstream tasks, ranging from molecular interactions and phenotypic dependencies to epigenetic regulation, confirm the validity and effectiveness of our proposed approach, where competitive performance is achieved across all evaluated benchmarks. We further validate the quality of the generated embeddings through comprehensive analyses, including embedding visualizations, intra-pathway similarity assessments, ablation study, and parameter analysis.
zh_abstract: 有效且高质量的基因功能表征对生物信息学任务至关重要。基因的生物学知识本质上是文本性的，包括功能描述和通路注释，而现有方法往往依赖单一来源的非文本数据，未能捕捉多来源基因注释中丰富的语义信息。本文提出 GeneEmbedLLM，一个由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的框架，用于生成通用的、具有语义感知的基因嵌入。该方法通过整合来自五个权威数据库的多来源结构化文本，并基于 Longformer 架构的属性感知注意力和对比学习，推进了基因表征学习。在从分子相互作用、表型依赖性到表观遗传调控等多种下游任务上的实验结果证实了所提方法的有效性，在所有评估基准上均取得了有竞争力的性能。我们还通过全面分析进一步验证了所生成嵌入的质量，包括嵌入可视化、通路内相似性评估、消融研究和参数分析。

title: Beyond Segmentation: Enriching ImageCAS with Coronary Ostia Landmarks, Rooted Centerline Graphs, and Open-Weight Localization Models
zh_title: ImageCAS扩展：冠脉开口标注、中心线图与开放权重定位模型
summary: 为ImageCAS的1000例患者补充冠脉开口标注和以开口为根的中心线图，并发布开放权重的定位模型。
key_points: 覆盖1000例CCTA患者
称为最大的公开冠脉开口定位数据集
发布开放权重定位模型
reason: 公开较大规模数据集与权重，但属预印本且为标注扩展
abstract: Coronary ostia and centerlines are key reference points for automated analysis of coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA), from surgical planning to intraoperative vessel tracking. However, the only public ostium annotations cover 77 non-gated aortic scans, not CCTA, while CAT08 and ASOCA (32 and 40 CCTA scans) mark the ostia only implicitly, as centerline start points. This work enriches ImageCAS, the largest public dataset for coronary artery segmentation, with ostium annotations for its 1000 patients and centerline graphs rooted at these new ostia, making it, to the authors' knowledge, the largest public dataset for ostium localization and the only one with centerlines following the official ImageCAS masks and starting at annotated ostia. Three annotators marked each ostium in the first 500 volumes; in the next 500, the candidates of a model trained on the first batch were corrected (human-in-the-loop). Six 3D localization models, trained on ImageCAS, CAT08 and ASOCA, were benchmarked on 58 held-out volumes (50 ImageCAS, 4 CAT08, 4 ASOCA). SwinUNETR-V2 and nnResUNet localized all ostia without failure (>5 mm error), with median errors of 0.70-0.87 mm. Trained on CAT08 and ASOCA alone, SwinUNETR-V2 fails on 34% of right and 53% of left ostia, whereas adding 250 ImageCAS volumes removes all failures. The centerlines were extracted by a deterministic, quality-controlled minimal-path procedure; on ASOCA, they cover a median of 99.5% of the reference length, with a median per-patient mean distance of 0.22 mm between matched reference points and centerlines. Annotations, centerlines, code, and weights are available at https://hal9000-lab.github.io/.
zh_abstract: 冠状动脉开口（ostia）和中心线是冠状动脉计算机断层扫描血管造影（CCTA）自动分析的关键参考点，应用范围从手术规划到术中血管追踪。然而，目前公开的开口标注仅涵盖77例非门控主动脉扫描，而非CCTA；CAT08和ASOCA（分别包含32例和40例CCTA扫描）仅将开口隐含地标记为中心线的起点。本研究为最大的公开冠状动脉分割数据集ImageCAS补充了其1000例患者的开口标注，以及以这些新开口为根的中心线图。据作者所知，这是目前最大的公开开口定位数据集，也是唯一一个中心线遵循ImageCAS官方掩膜且起始于已标注开口的数据集。三名标注者对前500个容积中的每个开口进行了标注；在后500个容积中，则对基于第一批数据训练的模型所给出的候选点进行校正（人在回路）。在58个留出容积（50个ImageCAS、4个CAT08、4个ASOCA）上，对在ImageCAS、CAT08和ASOCA上训练的六种三维定位模型进行了基准测试。SwinUNETR-V2和nnResUNet定位所有开口均无失败（误差>5 mm），中位误差为0.70-0.87 mm。仅在CAT08和ASOCA上训练时，SwinUNETR-V2在34%的右侧开口和53%的左侧开口上失败，而加入250个ImageCAS容积后，所有失败均被消除。中心线由确定性的、经质量控制的最小路径程序提取；在ASOCA上，其覆盖参考长度的中位数为99.5%，匹配的参考点与中心线之间的每位患者平均距离的中位数为0.22 mm。标注、中心线、代码和权重可在 https://hal9000-lab.github.io/ 获取。

title: ProtoCouncil: Multi-Encoder Anatomical Prototypes for Prostate Cancer Detection in Micro-Ultrasound
zh_title: ProtoCouncil：多编码器解剖原型用于微超声前列腺癌检测
summary: 用MedSAM、DINOv3、V-JEPA 2.1三种基础编码器学习多层级解剖原型，实现可追溯的微超声前列腺癌检测并在编码器分歧时选择性预测。
key_points: 三层解剖原型：全腺体、针道、腺体分区
编码器分歧触发选择性预测
693例患者6588个活检核的五折交叉验证
reason: 新颖可解释方法，但仅内部交叉验证的预印本
abstract: Purpose: Micro-ultrasound ($μ$US) is a promising modality for prostate cancer (PCa) detection, but identifying suspicious tissue depends heavily on clinical experience. Models trained on sparse, noisy core-level pathology offer little insight into their decisions and can fail under domain shift. Clinical use needs a traceable decision process and a flag for uncertain predictions. Methods: We introduce ProtoCouncil, in which three foundation encoders (MedSAM, DINOv3 and V-JEPA 2.1) learn case-based prototypes at three anatomical levels: whole gland, needle track and gland sectors. Prototypes are projected onto real training-core regions, and label-free fusion keeps every class logit as a bias plus an exact sum of prototype similarity contributions. Encoder disagreement triggers selective prediction. Results: In five-fold patient-level cross-validation (6,588 cores, 693 patients), ProtoCouncil reaches 82.9% AUROC for clinically significant PCa (csPCa, Grade Group $\geq$3), 4.3 points above the best previously published method. In zero-shot evaluation on two external cohorts, ProtoCouncil achieves higher all-cancer and csPCa AUROC than all previous methods. Nearest same-class exemplars match test-core tumor involvement better than random same-class cases. Externally, csPCa accuracy falls from 79% when encoders agree to 27% when two oppose the fused call. Abstaining on disagreement raises balanced accuracy by 7 and 15 points, while retaining 58% and 54% of the cores. Conclusion: ProtoCouncil grounds core-level predictions in exact similarity-based evidence from real, anatomically indexed training cases, which makes its reasoning interpretable. It achieves the highest csPCa AUROC across three cohorts and identifies unreliable predictions through encoder disagreement.

title: Interpretable Context-Aware Multi-Label Retinal Classification with Dual-Hub Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network
zh_title: 双中枢异构图网络用于可解释的多标签视网膜分类
summary: 提出融合眼底图像与临床协变量的双中枢异构GNN，在BRSET数据集上七种病症Macro-AUPRC为76.1%。
key_points: 跨模态消息传递并内置可解释性
BRSET含16,266张照片、8,524名患者
七种疾病Macro-AUPRC 76.1%
reason: 预印本，公开数据集有基线对比，无外部验证
abstract: Multi-label retinal screening requires capturing co-occurring pathologies and clinical context, yet standard multimodal fusion remains opaque. We propose a dual-hub heterogeneous graph neural network (GNN) that couples spatial fundus features and structured clinical covariates through cross-modal message passing while providing inherent interpretability. Rather than relying on post-hoc saliency approximations, our architecture exposes multi-level decision pathways during forward aggregation: spatially biased self-attention captures lesion-level patch interactions, while modality-specific graph attention coefficients explicitly quantify the contribution of visual regions and clinical risk factors to each disease node. Evaluated on the BRSET dataset (16,266 photographs from 8,524 patients), the proposed model achieves 76.1% Macro-AUPRC across seven conditions, matching or exceeding image-only (75.9%) and ResNet-50+MLP fusion (75.9%) baselines, with largest contextual gains in macular edema (+3.5%) and diabetic retinopathy (+2.1%). Codebase is available at: https://github.com/proshanto-c/ca-mlc-refactor.
zh_abstract: 多标签视网膜筛查需要捕捉并存的病变和临床背景，但标准的多模态融合仍不透明。我们提出了一种双中枢（dual-hub）异质图神经网络（GNN），通过跨模态消息传递耦合眼底空间特征与结构化临床协变量，同时具备内在可解释性。我们的架构不依赖事后显著性近似，而是在前向聚合过程中呈现多层级决策路径：空间偏置自注意力捕捉病灶级图像块之间的相互作用，而模态特异性图注意力系数则明确量化视觉区域和临床危险因素对每个疾病节点的贡献。在BRSET数据集（来自8,524名患者的16,266张照片）上评估，所提模型在七种疾病上取得76.1%的宏平均AUPRC，与仅图像基线（75.9%）和ResNet-50+MLP融合基线（75.9%）相当或更优，其中黄斑水肿（+3.5%）和糖尿病视网膜病变（+2.1%）的上下文增益最大。代码库见：https://github.com/proshanto-c/ca-mlc-refactor。

title: Multilingual Artificial Datasets for AI-Driven Cardiology: the CliTe and ParaCliTe corpora
zh_title: 面向心脏病学的多语言人工语料CliTe与ParaCliTe
summary: 来自7家欧洲医院的心脏病学专家生成7种语言的人工临床记录，发布CliTe、ParaCliTe等多语言语料。
key_points: 七种语言的人工心脏病学临床记录
部分子集经多阶段人工翻译形成平行语料
其余报告为自动翻译的Silver版本
reason: 新多语言数据集有价值，但为人工合成且规模与验证信息有限
abstract: Background and Aims. Comparable, multilingual, validated cardiology corpora are critical to advance trustworthy natural language processing (NLP) models for cardiology but such resources are scarce due to privacy concerns. This study aimed to cover this gap by presenting suitable artificial corpus creation guidelines and by releasing 3 multilanguage corpora. Methods. Following purpose-specific publicly-available corpus construction guidelines, cardiologists from 7 European hospitals generated artificial clinical records in Czech, Dutch, English, Italian, Romanian, Spanish and Swedish, ensuring clinical diversity and sex balance, resulting in the CliTe corpus. A CliTe subset underwent a multi-stage manual translation into the other 6 languages, resulting in the parallel ParaCliTe corpus, while the remaining reports were automatically translated, constituting ParaCliTe Silver. Results. CliTe is a collection of 699 artificial cardiology reports, mostly outpatient notes (340 documents), discharge reports (263), and inpatient notes (89), describing fictional patients with ischaemic heart disease (199 patients), heart failure (188), and valvular disease (79), among others. ParaCliTe contains reports from 94 fictitious patients, each available in seven languages with sentence-level alignment, resulting in 658 documents. The corpus mainly comprises discharge reports (322 documents), and outpatient (196) and inpatient (140) notes, describing patients with heart failure (399 documents), ischaemic heart disease (287), and valvular disease (238). Empirical results illustrate the utility of ParaCliTe and highlight the limitations of state-of-the-art NLP models adapted to the cardiology domain. Conclusions. The creation of multilingual, equitable and realistic corpora of artificial patients capable of strengthening NLP performance for cardiology is feasible when supported by detailed guidelines.
zh_abstract: 【背景与目的】可比较的、多语言的、经过验证的心脏病学语料库对于推进可信的心脏病学自然语言处理（NLP）模型至关重要，但由于隐私顾虑，此类资源十分稀缺。本研究旨在通过提出合适的人工语料库构建指南并发布 3 个多语言语料库来填补这一空白。【方法】遵循针对特定目的的公开可得语料库构建指南，来自 7 家欧洲医院的心脏病专家以捷克语、荷兰语、英语、意大利语、罗马尼亚语、西班牙语和瑞典语生成了人工临床记录，确保临床多样性和性别平衡，由此形成 CliTe 语料库。CliTe 的一个子集经过多阶段人工翻译成其他 6 种语言，形成平行语料库 ParaCliTe，其余报告则通过自动翻译，构成 ParaCliTe Silver。【结果】CliTe 是由 699 份人工心脏病学报告组成的集合，主要为门诊记录（340 份）、出院报告（263 份）和住院记录（89 份），描述的虚构患者包括缺血性心脏病（199 例）、心力衰竭（188 例）和瓣膜病（79 例）等。ParaCliTe 包含 94 名虚构患者的报告，每份均有七种语言版本并具有句子级对齐，共 658 份文档。该语料库主要包括出院报告（322 份）、门诊记录（196 份）和住院记录（140 份），描述的患者为心力衰竭（399 份文档）、缺血性心脏病（287 份）和瓣膜病（238 份）。实证结果说明了 ParaCliTe 的实用性，并凸显了适配于心脏病学领域的最先进 NLP 模型的局限性。【结论】在详细指南的支持下，创建多语言、公平且真实的人工患者语料库以提升心脏病学 NLP 的性能是可行的。

title: MSR-ABC: Complementary Feature Fusion for Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma Classification
zh_title: MSR-ABC：融合互补特征的透明细胞肾癌CT分类
summary: 整合MedVAE、MedSigLIP与影像组学的全局-局部框架，在KiTS23病例与外部队列上评估ccRCC分类。
key_points: 融合重建特征、图文嵌入与影像组学
跨表示注意力与门控残差
396例KiTS23加外部队列评估
reason: 有外部队列的新方法预印本，但样本较小、证据有限
abstract: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) classification from computed tomography (CT) may benefit from representations that capture different aspects of tumour phenotype. However, simply concatenating reconstruction-derived features, image--text embeddings, and radiomic descriptors may not fully exploit their complementary information. We propose MSR-ABC, a global--local framework integrating MedVAE, MedSigLIP, and radiomics. Spatially matched local image descriptors interact through cross-representation attention, while radiomic auxiliary supervision encourages the pooled local representation to retain quantitative tumour attributes. A gated residual mechanism integrates local information with global summaries. Area-aware pooling and visual and soft-text prompting complete the framework. We evaluate discrimination using a patient-level split of 396 KiTS23 cases and an external cohort of 111 TCGA/TCIA cases, reporting mean AUROC over three training seeds with 95% patient-bootstrap confidence intervals. MSR-ABC achieves mean AUROCs of 0.806 internally and 0.879 externally. Internally, it exceeds global MedVAE--radiomics and three-source concatenation by 3.35 and 3.61 AUROC percentage points, respectively. Removing any source lowers mean AUROC in both cohorts, with the largest decreases following radiomics removal. Individual removal of cross-representation attention, auxiliary supervision, or gated fusion also lowers internal mean AUROC. These findings are consistent with complementary contributions within the integrated architecture and support further investigation of structured representation fusion for non-invasive renal tumour characterisation.

abstract: The 2026 ImageCLEFmedical GANs Task Exploring Fingerprint Detection, Privacy Leakage, and Synthetic Medical Image Generation continues to investigate privacy and security concerns around using patient data to generate synthetic medical images, now in its fourth edition. This edition introduces three complementary subtasks: the first extends prior editions by asking participants to detect which real images were used in training a Generative Adversarial Network to produce given synthetic outputs; the second is a novel subtask requiring participants to identify which latent vector produced each synthetic image, probing the faithfulness and reversibility of the latent-to-image mapping; the third asks participants to generate privacy-preserving CT slices, quantifying the trade-off between image fidelity and patient privacy. Ground-truth annotations and benchmark datasets of real and GAN-generated lung CT slices are provided for all subtasks. Evaluation is based on Cohen's Kappa for Subtask 1, matching accuracy for Subtask 2, and a combination of FID and Privacy Preservation Score (PPS) for Subtask 3. Overall, 37 teams registered for the task, with 10 teams submitting runs across subtasks and 6 teams submitting working notes papers. This paper presents an overview of the task setup, datasets, evaluation metrics, and summarises the approaches and results of participating teams.

abstract: Controllable molecule generation is crucial for diverse scientific applications, such as drug discovery and materials design. While large language models (LLMs) show great promise, their dense and entangled representations impede precise control over the generation of molecules with bespoke substructures or properties. To address this, we propose Sparse Representation Editing (SpaRE), an interpretability-driven framework for fine-grained and precise control in LLM-based molecule generation. The crux of SpaRE is to learn an overcomplete sparse feature space that disentangles LLM representations into a compact set of latent features corresponding to chemically meaningful concepts. Within this space, we can directly manipulate these concept-aligned latent features to achieve (1) local control, by generating target atoms and functional groups at specified positions; and (2) global control, by customizing the overall structural and physicochemical properties within defined ranges. In this way, our framework advances interpretability from post-hoc analysis to actionable generative control. Experiments show that SpaRE can generate chemically desirable molecules under complex constraints in real-world scenarios, while offering mechanistic insights for quantitative structure-property analysis. The code and demo are available at https://github.com/WanyuGroup/ICML2026_SpaRE.
zh_abstract: 可控的分子生成对药物发现和材料设计等多种科学应用至关重要。尽管大语言模型（LLM）展现出巨大潜力，但其稠密且相互纠缠的表征阻碍了对具有特定子结构或性质的分子生成进行精确控制。为此，我们提出稀疏表征编辑（Sparse Representation Editing，SpaRE），这是一种以可解释性为驱动、用于基于LLM的分子生成中实现细粒度精确控制的框架。SpaRE 的核心是学习一个过完备的稀疏特征空间，将LLM表征解耦为一组与具有化学意义的概念相对应的紧凑潜在特征。在该空间内，我们可以直接操控这些与概念对齐的潜在特征，从而实现：（1）局部控制，即在指定位置生成目标原子和官能团；（2）全局控制，即在限定范围内定制整体结构和物理化学性质。通过这种方式，我们的框架将可解释性从事后分析推进到可操作的生成控制。实验表明，SpaRE 能够在真实场景的复杂约束下生成化学上符合期望的分子，同时为定量构效关系分析提供机制层面的见解。代码和演示见 https://github.com/WanyuGroup/ICML2026_SpaRE。

title: KnowEvo: Knowledge Evolution for Protein Optimization

summary: 提出KnowEvo框架，将外化的科学知识本身作为优化对象，用于LLM驱动的蛋白质优化。
key_points: 知识可检查、评估与改进

reason: 科学发现智能体方向的新方法预印本，证据有限
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in scientific discovery, yet systematically accumulating and refining reusable scientific knowledge remains challenging. Existing approaches primarily improve LLM-based problem solving through parameter optimization or feedback-driven refinement of prompts, programs, and solution trajectories, leaving acquired expertise either embedded in model weights or scattered across iterative problem-solving processes. As a result,knowledge is difficult to systematically inspect, evaluate, and refine. We propose KnowEvo, a framework that treats externalized knowledge itself as the optimization target. Our key insight is that scientific knowledge is inherently modular: multiple interacting mechanisms jointly determine the design outcomes. This makes knowledge evolution fundamentally challenging, as improvements cannot be attributed to individual components in isolation. To address this, KnowEvo represents knowledge as executable expertise blocks and organizes their refinements into strategy mutation trees, enabling structured exploration over a combinatorial knowledge space. The framework combines a Thompson-style forward allocation strategy that adaptively distributes evaluation budgets across strategy variants with a backward revision process, in which a code agent operates in an isolated sandbox to translate rollout evidence into localized program updates. This design enables persistent accumulation, evaluation, and refinement of mechanistic expertise across iterative experimentation. We evaluate KnowEvo on protein optimization tasks including stability and solubility. Results show that knowledge evolution consistently improves over initial strategy blocks and outperforms monolithic program evolution and prior LLM-guided evolution baselines across metrics such as pass@k, MRR, MAP,and NDCG@5. Code is available at https://github.com/recynie/KnowEvo.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在科学发现方面已展现出潜力，但系统性地积累和完善可复用的科学知识仍具挑战。现有方法主要通过参数优化，或基于反馈对提示词、程序和求解轨迹进行改进，来提升基于LLM的问题求解能力，使得所获得的专业知识要么嵌入模型权重中，要么分散在迭代求解过程里。因此，知识难以被系统地检查、评估和完善。我们提出KnowEvo框架，将外部化的知识本身作为优化目标。我们的核心洞见是：科学知识本质上是模块化的，多种相互作用的机制共同决定设计结果。这使得知识演化从根本上具有挑战性，因为改进无法孤立地归因于单个组成部分。为此，KnowEvo将知识表示为可执行的专业知识块，并将其改进组织为策略变异树，从而能够在组合式知识空间中进行结构化探索。该框架将Thompson式前向分配策略与后向修订过程相结合：前者在各策略变体之间自适应地分配评估预算；后者中，代码智能体在隔离的沙箱中运行，将rollout证据转化为局部的程序更新。这一设计使机制性专业知识能够在迭代实验中得以持续积累、评估和完善。我们在包括稳定性和溶解性在内的蛋白质优化任务上评估了KnowEvo。结果显示，知识演化相比初始策略块持续取得改进，并在pass@k、MRR、MAP和NDCG@5等指标上优于整体式程序演化以及既往LLM引导的演化基线。代码见 https://github.com/recynie/KnowEvo。

title: Causal graph fusion across incomplete cohorts and causal steering of tabular foundation models

abstract: Clinical data are split across incomplete cohorts with partially overlapping variables. Causal discovery under missing data and multi-source integration have developed separately, and tabular foundation models cannot take a causal graph without retraining. We make two contributions. First, causal graph fusion learns a partial ancestral graph on the shared variables, fuses it into each cohort's graph under temporal background knowledge and lets Markov blankets guide re-imputation, so missing data are handled inside discovery. Second, causal attention steering compiles the learned graph into the attention of a frozen tabular foundation model at inference. Against known ground truth, fusion dominates pooled and per-cohort baselines in every missingness and heterogeneity condition tested (p<0.001), and steering improves discrimination under distribution shift (p<10^{-5}), a gain that a random graph does not produce. In two spinal cord injury cohorts, fusion orients age, albumin and hemoglobin as ancestors of length of stay, a set no single cohort orients in full, and yields compact, temporally ordered predictor sets that match or exceed automatic feature selection on four of five outcomes.
zh_abstract: 临床数据分散在变量部分重叠的不完整队列中。缺失数据下的因果发现与多源整合此前各自独立发展，而表格基础模型在不重新训练的情况下无法接受因果图。我们做出两项贡献。第一，因果图融合（causal graph fusion）在共享变量上学习部分祖先图，在时间背景知识下将其融合到各队列的图中，并让马尔可夫毯引导重新插补，从而在发现过程中处理缺失数据。第二，因果注意力引导（causal attention steering）在推理时将学得的图编译到冻结的表格基础模型的注意力中。以已知真实结构为参照，在所测试的每一种缺失和异质性条件下，融合均优于合并数据和单队列基线（p<0.001），而引导可在分布偏移下改善区分能力（p<10^{-5}），随机图则不能产生这种增益。在两个脊髓损伤队列中，融合将年龄、白蛋白和血红蛋白确定为住院时间的祖先变量，这一集合没有任何单一队列能够完整确定；并得到紧凑、具有时间顺序的预测变量集，在五项结局中的四项上与自动特征选择相当或更优。

title: RuACT: Recovering Inactive Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers

summary: 针对基于评分细则的强化学习中大量细则失活的问题，提出利用不可达细则作特权信息自蒸馏，并在医学训练中验证。

abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) extends RL with verifiable rewards to open-ended tasks by scoring each response against query-specific rubrics. Under group-relative optimization, however, a rubric that every sampled response fails (unreachable) or passes (saturated) gives all responses the same outcome and no learning signal; in Qwen3-4B medical training, 60.88% of query-rubric observations are inactive. We find that the two states lack different supervision: stating an unreachable rubric in the prompt raises its satisfaction from 1.13% to 91.25%, whereas responses that all pass a saturated rubric still differ in quality. We therefore propose RuACT (Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers), which assigns each inactive rubric the role that supplies what it lacks. Rubric as Teacher uses unreachable rubrics as privileged information for reward-gated on-policy self-distillation, and Rubric as Critic decomposes saturated rubrics into child rubrics that separate current responses while sharing the parent's weight. RuACT outperforms GRPO, rubric reweighting, and rubric-guided exploration on all four medical and scientific benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and achieves the best average with Qwen3-1.7B. On initially unreachable rubrics, unguided recovery rises from 35.02% to 42.86%, while child refinement improves reward-quality alignment on independent rollouts from 57.74% to 60.77%. Code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/RuACT.
zh_abstract: 基于评分细则（rubric）的强化学习（RL）通过依据针对每个查询的评分细则对每条回答打分，将可验证奖励的强化学习扩展到开放式任务。然而，在组内相对优化下，若某条评分细则被所有采样回答都未满足（不可达）或都满足（饱和），则所有回答获得相同的结果，也就没有学习信号；在 Qwen3-4B 的医学训练中，60.88% 的查询-评分细则观测是无效的。我们发现这两种状态缺少的监督不同：在提示中陈述不可达的评分细则，可使其满足率从 1.13% 提高到 91.25%；而对于全部通过饱和评分细则的回答，其质量仍存在差异。因此，我们提出 RuACT（Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers，评分细则作为自适应评判者与教师），为每条无效评分细则分配其所缺少的那种作用。“评分细则作为教师”将不可达评分细则用作特权信息，进行奖励门控的在线策略自蒸馏；“评分细则作为评判者”则将饱和评分细则分解为能够区分当前回答、并共享父级权重的子评分细则。在 Qwen3-4B 上，RuACT 在全部四个医学和科学基准上均优于 GRPO、评分细则重加权和评分细则引导探索，并在 Qwen3-1.7B 上取得最佳平均成绩。在最初不可达的评分细则上，无引导恢复率从 35.02% 上升到 42.86%，而子评分细则的细化使独立 rollout 上的奖励-质量一致性从 57.74% 提高到 60.77%。代码见 https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/RuACT。

abstract: Intracranial EEG provides high signal-to-noise ratio and spatial resolution for detecting epileptic activity, but patient-specific electrode placement leads to substantial variation in channel count and montage across subjects. This heterogeneity limits the generalization of existing detectors under subject-independent evaluation. We propose MOSAIC (MOntage-agnostic Self-distilled Adaptive Inter-channel Connectivity learning), a lightweight graph-learning framework for subject-independent iEEG seizure detection. MOSAIC pairs a shared convolutional channel encoder with a patient-agnostic channel-attention module that infers a weighted inter-channel adjacency matrix from the encoded features, requiring no fixed montage graph. An exponential moving average self-distillation objective regularizes each prediction toward a slowly updated per-patient teacher. Across four public iEEG corpora (SWEC-ETHZ long- and short-term, Mayo, FNUSA), MOSAIC outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in F2 and Cohen's $κ$ while learning more stable inter-channel adjacencies, demonstrating that self-distilled connectivity learning transfers across unseen implantations.

abstract: [EJNMMI physics] Accurate myocardial segmentation is essential for polar map-based quantitative analysis in SPECT myocardial perfusion imaging (MPI). Commercial software requires significant manual adjustment to ensure accurate segmentation, particularly for studies with severe myocardial defects or high extracardiac uptake. To address this limitation, we propose deep learning (DL)-based myocardial segmentation using non-contrast-enhanced CT images. Myocardial masks were generated by simply thresholding PET images with uniform myocardial uptake in 125 18F-FDG PET/CT studies. An optimal network was configured through the nn-UNet pipeline with CT images as input and the masks as labels. For evaluation, the network was tested on 50 99mTc-sestamibi SPECT/CT MPI studies with uniform myocardial uptake. Additional 50 SPECT MPI studies with severe myocardial defects or high extracardiac uptake were selected to demonstrate the impact of using DL-masks on polar map-based quantification. Three nuclear cardiologists visually compared myocardium contours with and without DL-masks in commercial software. DL-masks achieved a Dice Similarity Coefficient of 0.866 ± 0.035 in the PET/CT validation set and 0.846 ± 0.026 in the SPECT/CT test set. For additional studies, segmental differences in the polar map with and without DL-masks indicated meaningful quantitative differences (~ 10%) in basal segments near the septum, compared to mid-cavity or apical segments. Likert scoring demonstrated that DL-masks improved septal and valve plane placement in commercial software, resulting in accurate myocardial segmentation without manual adjustment. We demonstrated a DL segmentation model for accurate myocardial segmentation without manual adjustment and corresponding polar map-based quantification, particularly in studies with severe myocardial defects or high extracardiac uptake.
zh_abstract: [EJNMMI physics] 准确的心肌分割对于SPECT心肌灌注显像（MPI）中基于极坐标图的定量分析至关重要。商用软件需要大量手动调整以确保分割准确，尤其是对于存在严重心肌缺损或心外高摄取的检查。为解决这一局限，我们提出使用非增强CT图像进行基于深度学习（DL）的心肌分割。在125例18F-FDG PET/CT检查中，对心肌摄取均匀的PET图像进行简单阈值处理，生成心肌掩模。以CT图像为输入、掩模为标签，通过nn-UNet流程配置出最优网络。评估时，该网络在50例心肌摄取均匀的99mTc-sestamibi SPECT/CT MPI检查上进行测试。另选取50例存在严重心肌缺损或心外高摄取的SPECT MPI检查，以展示使用DL掩模对基于极坐标图的定量的影响。三名核心脏病学医师在商用软件中目视比较了使用与不使用DL掩模时的心肌轮廓。DL掩模在PET/CT验证集中的Dice相似系数为0.866 ± 0.035，在SPECT/CT测试集中为0.846 ± 0.026。对于额外的检查，与中腔或心尖节段相比，使用与不使用DL掩模时极坐标图的节段差异显示，靠近室间隔的基底段存在有意义的定量差异（约10%）。Likert评分表明，DL掩模改善了商用软件中室间隔和瓣膜平面的放置，从而无需手动调整即可获得准确的心肌分割。我们展示了一种无需手动调整即可实现准确心肌分割的DL分割模型，以及相应的基于极坐标图的定量，尤其适用于存在严重心肌缺损或心外高摄取的检查。

abstract: [Journal of nursing management] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in healthcare organizations, influencing workforce management, operational decision-making, quality monitoring, and resource allocation. While AI offers opportunities to improve efficiency and organizational performance, its implementation also introduces significant ethical challenges related to privacy, transparency, accountability, bias, and workforce equity. Nurse leaders occupy a pivotal position in shaping how AI is integrated into healthcare systems and ensuring that technological innovation aligns with professional nursing values. This editorial examines ethical AI governance as a leadership imperative in nursing management, drawing on the American Nurses Association Code of Ethics, World Health Organization guidance, leadership theory, sociotechnical systems theory, and equity-centered scholarship. Key ethical concerns associated with AI-enabled management are explored, including algorithmic bias, workforce surveillance, explainability, and accountability in decision-making. As AI continues to transform healthcare operations, nursing leadership must move beyond technology implementation toward intentional governance that ensures AI is deployed in ways that are transparent, equitable, and consistent with the profession's moral commitments.
